description: Full-text search of a state's codified law (GET /v1/statutes/search). Use for 'what does the law say about X' and to find the section a bill or ballot measure changes. Returns matching sections with headings and excerpts; fetch the whole section with get_statute. Only states whose code is loaded resolve to section text (see list_statute_coverage); a link to a section we hold carries resolved:true and the text, otherwise just the citation as written.

code.description: Restrict to one code (code_key from list_statute_coverage), e.g. a California code.

q.description: Words to find in section headings and text.

state.description: 2-letter postal code (e.g. NJ), DC, GU, or US for the U.S. Code.

name: search_statutes
title: Search statutes
